title: Cryptotest HKDF Testvector
description: A list of testvectors for HKDF testing

test_case_id.description: Incremental test case ID -- used for debugging

algorithm.description: The ACVP algorithm the test came from

mode.description: The ACVP mode the test came from

revision.description: ACVP algorithm revision the test came from

is_sample.description: Whether the ACVP vector set is a sample

vs_id.description: ACVP vector set ID the test came from

tg_id.description: ACVP test group ID the test came from

operation.description: derive to answer with the derived key, or validate to check `okm` against it

hash_alg.description: Hash function of the underlying HMAC

info.description: Info, the FixedInfo of the ACVP test

okm_len.description: Length of the output keying material in bytes

okm.description: Output keying material, the expected one or the one to validate

result.description: Whether the derived key should match `okm`
